transcript.content: Cluster 258's top up-regulated markers are: tnn, tgfbi, col1a2, col1a1b, col5a1, ccl25b, col5a2a, matn4. Using ZFIN curated expression, ZFA anatomy, and GO, identify the most likely zebrafish cell type (with state if the markers support it), grounding each claim in a cited record. If the evidence is ambiguous, say so.

**Most likely identity: collagen-secreting fibroblast / mesenchymal connective-tissue cell, likely mature ECM-producing.**

## Evidence
- **col1a2** — type I collagen; expressed in cranium, dermomyotome, integument, muscle, and pectoral fin; predicted extracellular-matrix tensile-strength constituent [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-8415).
- **col1a1b** — type I collagen alpha chain; expressed in integument, muscle, osteoblast, trunk, and corneal epithelium; supports collagenous mesenchymal/connective identity [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-4400).
- **col5a1** — type V collagen; curated expression includes fin actinotrichium/heart contexts, consistent with ECM-rich connective populations rather than epithelial or immune identity [record](https://zfin.org/action/marker/ZDB-GENE-041105-6/expression).
- **tgfbi** — extracellular-matrix/space protein; expressed in head mesenchyme, neural crest cell, paraxial mesoderm, and splanchnocranium [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-73).
- **matn4** — matrilin ECM gene; expressed in skeletal system, integument, hypochord, vertical myoseptum, and nervous system [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050208-64).
- **tnn** — tenascin N; predicted integrin binding, cell-matrix adhesion, extracellular matrix/space activity [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-262).
- **ZFA fibroblast** — defined as a connective-tissue cell secreting collagen-rich extracellular matrix, matching the collagen/ECM marker program [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-TERM-100331-2084).
- **GO:0030020** — extracellular matrix structural constituent conferring tensile strength; explicitly covers collagen ECM proteins [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0030020).

## Caveats
- **ccl25b** adds chemokine/hematopoietic-niche signaling, but the dominant marker program is ECM/collagen, not immune-lineage.

**Verdict:** fibroblast / mesenchymal connective-tissue cell, mature ECM-producing — confidence high

**Most likely: collagen-producing mesenchymal/fibroblast-like ECM cell; alternatives: skeletal/fin connective tissue or myoseptal/dermomyotome-associated progenitor.**

## Evidence
- **col1a2** — strongest “obvious” fibroblast/ECM clue: type I collagen, GO-linked to extracellular matrix tensile strength, expressed in cranium, dermomyotome, integument, muscle, and pectoral fin; a ZFIN-curated paper explicitly describes **col1a2+ fibroblasts/muscle progenitors**, so fibroblast-like mesenchyme is favored but not uniquely localized. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-8415?utm_source=openai))
- **col1a1b** — another type I collagen; ZFIN expression includes integument, muscle, osteoblast, trunk, and corneal epithelium, supporting ECM-producing connective/skeletal-lineage cells rather than epithelium alone. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-4400?utm_source=openai))
- **col5a1 / col5a2a** — type V collagen ECM constituents; col5a1 is expressed in dermis, dermomyotome, head, neural crest, notochord, while col5a2a is expressed in epidermis, median fin fold, paraxial mesoderm, pectoral fin, and pharyngeal arch. This broad mesenchymal/integument/fin distribution argues against a single precise cell type. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-041105-6?utm_source=openai))
- **tgfbi** — extracellular-matrix/cell-adhesion gene expressed in head mesenchyme, neural crest cell, paraxial mesoderm, and splanchnocranium; supports mesenchymal ECM, with a muscle-development association as an alternative pull. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-73?utm_source=openai))
- **matn4** — ECM-active, expressed in hypochord, integument, nervous system, skeletal system, and vertical myoseptum; this keeps skeletal/myoseptal connective tissue plausible. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050208-64?utm_source=openai))
- **ZFA anatomy** — candidate sites include collagen-rich dermis/stratum compactum and pectoral fin/fin skeleton; pectoral fin is a thoracic paired fin, while stratum compactum is collagenous dermis, fitting the marker set but not resolving cell identity. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/action/ontology/term/UBERON%3A0007377?utm_source=openai))

## Caveats
- No single marker here is uniquely fibroblast-specific; the deepest defensible tier is **mesenchymal/connective ECM-producing cell**, not dermal fibroblast vs fin/skeletal fibroblast.
- **ccl25b** adds immune/HSPC-niche signaling, but not enough to call hematopoietic identity. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-110222-2?utm_source=openai))

**Verdict:** collagen-producing mesenchymal/fibroblast-like ECM cell — confidence medium
